symptom: Typecheck and generationFeedback suite cannot parse the software-renderer detector. Prior software-rendered batch confirmation timed out after click action done.
direct_cause: Unescaped opening parenthesis in regex; experimental-webgl expands the getContext return union. Without software-renderer admission, real SwiftShader batch confirmation blocks after the completed click; controlled built-bundle regression reproduces the exact 30s timeout.
class_root: Shared motion admission lacks a typed and tested renderer classification boundary.
internal_only_reason: Local TypeScript DOM overload and renderer string classification, no external protocol changes.
invariants: Every renderer classification is executable and software rendering selects static motion.
generality_proof: All waiting and status surfaces use the same tested detector; table covers renderer families instead of model/provider branches.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Classify WebGL capability before motion admission.

prevention.invariant: One typed WebGL probe and constant pattern table classify all renderer inputs.
prevention.failure_mode: Missing or throwing context selects static surface.
prevention.strategy: Replace invalid composite regex with tested constant patterns and remove legacy experimental context branch.

legacy_paths.rationale: Removed invalid monolithic regex and obsolete experimental-webgl context request.

residual_risks: A future software renderer with no software/SwiftShader/llvmpipe identity would require extending the same pattern table and fixtures.
